_why: Committed demo data for the Specimen, so the screenshot in the README is reproducible. It carries a deliberately failing system rather than a clean one: the dominant action colour clears AA only at large sizes, one motion duration sits past the Doherty threshold, one spacing step is off the grid, one NOTE runs past its character budget with nothing structured to draw, and the icon and gradient spreads show the SYSTEM (grid, keylines, optical stroke, derived stops) rather than a contact sheet. A demo in which nothing is wrong demonstrates nothing.
philosophy: One dominant action colour. Three registers instead of one voice everywhere. Soft radii, with exactly one exception.

spreads.title: Colour

notes.text: Red stays the only dominant action colour per view.
notes.rule: One dominant action colour per view

notes.text: Alert green never in the same view as beginner green.
notes.antiRule: two greens that appear to mean the same thing

spreads.observation: Action red reaches 3.84:1 on white — enough for large text and borders, too little for body copy. A ghost button with a red label at text size fails.

spreads.title: Contrast

notes.text: Measured, not asserted. The thresholds show the distance: 3.44 against 4.5 is a graze, 1.20 is a different colour.
The dashed line marks a value whose provenance is only grade C — direction, not a token value.
notes.antiRule: passing an estimated value off as measured

spreads.observation: Hairline is meant as a divider, not as text. At 1.20:1 that is a rule, not an observation.

spreads.title: Icon System

notes.text: 24 grid, 20 live area, stroke 2 — derived from the base of 4, not decreed.
notes.rule: Every icon fills one of the four keylines
notes.antiRule: an icon that sits in no keyline reads a different size beside its neighbours
an icon with no label as the only carrier of meaning

notes.text: The wordmark is not part of this: a logo is drawn once, an icon set is rendered at many sizes.
notes.antiRule: carrying the logo geometry over onto icons

spreads.observation: Twelve seeds, not a library. The growth rule is the deliverable — until an own set exists, one open set is adopted whole, never two mixed.
spreads.snippet: python3 scripts/icons.py --sprite   # 12 seeds, checked against the grid

spreads.title: Gradients

notes.text: Both endpoints are roles, not literals — change the role and the gradient changes with it.
notes.antiRule: writing hex values straight into the gradient

notes.text: The action gradient stays within one hue. Two hues would be a second dominant action colour through the back door.
notes.antiRule: a gradient across two colour families

notes.text: UI surfaces only. In illustration, tone comes from flat zones and their overlap, not from a blend.
notes.antiRule: a gradient inside an illustration zone

spreads.observation: A third stop is a decision that has to be justified — usually it is two gradients under one name.

spreads.title: Typography

steps.label: UI & body copy — Plus Jakarta Sans

notes.text: Three registers instead of one voice everywhere: Anton for poster headlines, at most once or twice a page, Plus Jakarta Sans for everything else.

This note has been made deliberately too long and runs far past its character budget without carrying a clean rule and anti-rule pair that a drawing could be anchored to at all; instead it describes, in clause after clause, everything a type family is supposed to achieve, and in doing so loses exactly the reader the sketchbook was made for.

spreads.observation: Eyebrows stay uppercase; only the weight gets lighter.

spreads.title: States

notes.text: Focus is not cosmetic — without it the system is unusable from the keyboard.
notes.rule: Every interactive element has a visible focus state

notes.text: Empty and loading states are still missing here, which makes them open questions rather than omissions.
notes.antiRule: passing a missing state off as a decision

spreads.observation: The ghost button carries action red as a border, not as a label at text size — exactly the case the contrast page rules out.

spreads.title: Motion

notes.text: The 400 ms line is the Doherty threshold: past it the surface feels sluggish rather than calm.
notes.antiRule: stretching duration as a design device

spreads.observation: Page change sits at 520 ms, the only value beyond the threshold.

spreads.title: Grid

notes.text: Every step is a multiple of the base — all but one.
notes.rule: Spacing steps are whole multiples of 4px
notes.antiRule: an in-between value that fitted once

spreads.observation: space-4 sits at 18px, which is 4.5x the base. Either 16 or 20 — or the base is wrong.

approval.framing: A basis for discussion, not a finished rulebook.
approval.criteria: Feedback on colour, imagery and the four templates — before production.
approval.covers: direction | direction and taxonomy | the whole system

# Tennis School — New Design Concept

One dominant action colour. Three registers. Soft radii with one exception.
